subtitle: Junior Mechatronics Engineer
personnal_description:
Thibaut Bourgeais, passionate Mechatronics Engineer
Welcome to my portfolio
professional_description: Graduated in 2024, I have one and a half years of experience in diverse positions and already carried out many projects. Fluent in English and French I am eager to work in a startup environment.
ckc_website_desc: A website, designed to sell CKC brand products. Whose concept is to bring 3D printing to people without skills or machines.
FPV_drone_desc: I assembled, welded and then programmed my kit racing drone. It must then be repaired and kept up to date when there is a crash
student_office_desc:
With 35 other students, we set up the "INS'Avengers" list where I am vice-president of communication and for which we had to find funding in order to make a film and do a whole week filled with activities. We were elected.
To succeed we learned a lot about teamwork, skills management and volunteerism. I was in charge of communication on the networks (as well as various assets that we were able to publish on these), the shooting and editing of the film and the website.
drinking_game_desc: I created an electronic drinking game whose box is made of 3mm laser cut MDF. Inside, an arduino UNO card is responsible for animating the games. The glasses are illuminated according to the game and an i2c LCD screen manages the display of instructions.
movies_desc: I was able in the personal, school or associative context, to make short films (documentary or fiction).
